title: Cascade Ortho Rider Reimbursement Schedule — Carry Percentage for Cases Already Moved
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: carry percentage on a change of orthodontist.** Each new orthodontist repeats part of the start-up work of a case that has already moved once. The recognised remaining-treatment fee is therefore multiplied by a carry percentage set by the number of transfer entries the case's records already carry.

| Transfer entries already on the case's records | Carry percentage |
|---|---|
| none | 100 percent (no reduction) |
| exactly one | 90 percent |
| two or more | 80 percent |

The transfer entries counted are those carrying the case's case number.

## Reading the bands

- With **0** transfer entries the carry percentage is 100 percent. With **1** it is 90 percent.
- With **2** it is 80 percent, and it stays at 80 percent at **3** or more.

*Hypothetical figures:* an amount of 2,140.00 becomes 1,926.00 at 90 percent and 1,712.00 at 80 percent.
